answer: To join the settlement set, an agent must lock a refundable bond priced in seasoned timber, a scarce receipt minted only after the agent finishes a continuous river of peer-attested jobs spanning many epochs. Every epoch the same key must also send a compact sparrow pulse whose sequence number matches the issuance log; a skipped, duplicated, or reused pulse slashes the bond and parks rewards. Because the receipt is minted serially from real work, a sybil farm has to wait out and fund a full history for each fake identity rather than cloning keys at once.
